newsitem.title: USA: Elite donors promised access to GOP Congress - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Elite donors promised access to GOP Congress - NYT.

text.p: Republican fund-raising drives in the last election implied that elite donors contributing at least $250,000 to the GOP would get special access to Congressional Republicans, the New York Times reported on Monday.

The paper based the story on solicitation letters, invitations and interviews with Republican fund-raisers, which it said showed the Party targeted its efforts towards large companies and people with pending interests in Washington.
The paper said a fact sheet distributed for one fund-raiser promised private meetings with House and Senate committee chairmen and lunch with Speaker Newt Gingrich and Bob Dole.

Haley Barbour, who was chairman of the Republican National Committee in January, told the paper that the offer of help made in one invitation to the Republican Convention in San Diego referred only to assistance in fund-raising matters.
